name: Ankle Circles

frames.label: Start
frames.cue: Sit tall with both legs extended and ankles relaxed.

frames.label: Right Ankle Flex
frames.cue: Circle your right ankle slowly through a comfortable range.

frames.label: Right Ankle Point
frames.cue: Continue the right ankle circles without moving your knee.

frames.label: Left Ankle Flex
frames.cue: Circle your left ankle slowly through a comfortable range.

frames.label: Left Ankle Point
frames.cue: Finish the left ankle circles while keeping the knee still.

safety: Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Move only at the ankle; keep the knees relaxed and still.
Reduce the circle size or stop if there is sharp ankle pain.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did Ankle Circles feel? Note stiffness, clicking or discomfort in either ankle.
